product.title: Sagrada Familia, Park Guell & Walking Private Tour with Tapas

description.text: Skip the hassle of planning—and the lines along the way—on this private tour of Barcelona’s heritage, architecture, and gastronomy that combines a walking tour with taxi rides to two less central destinations. Traveling with a personal guide lets you maximize your time and discover parts of the city you would likely miss on your own. Stops include Gothic Quarter, Sagrada Familia, Park Güell, Rambla de Catalunya. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so visitors can focus on Gaudí architecture, Mediterranean views, and neighborhood walking or cycling highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
